# Quy Nhon Life

> Live ship tracking, weather, sunset forecasts and tropical storm tracking for Quy Nhon, a coastal city in Gia Lai province (formerly Binh Dinh), central Vietnam. Ship positions come from the site's own AIS radio receiver overlooking Quy Nhon Bay. The four pages below are available in English, Vietnamese, Korean, Chinese and Japanese.

## Pages

- [Live ship map](https://quynhonlife.com/): every vessel the antenna hears in Quy Nhon Bay, with current weather, wave height, a sunset forecast, Port Pulse arrivals and departures, and recent activity.
- [Storm Tracker](https://quynhonlife.com/storms): tropical storms and typhoons near Quy Nhon, with each storm's track, forecast path and expected closest approach. Data from GDACS.
- [Port in Numbers](https://quynhonlife.com/trends): the site's own record of every ship seen: unique vessels, flags, vessel types, daily arrivals, frequent visitors and the largest ships.
- [What's That Boat?](https://quynhonlife.com/spot): point a phone at a ship from the shore to identify it, using GPS, the compass and live AIS data.

## Other languages

- Vietnamese: https://quynhonlife.com/vi/
- Korean: https://quynhonlife.com/ko/
- Chinese: https://quynhonlife.com/zh/
- Japanese: https://quynhonlife.com/ja/

Each page has the same address under the language prefix, for example https://quynhonlife.com/vi/storms.
